title: Next message
hint: Predicted from recent conversation. Edit before sending.
copied: Copied. You can paste it into the main input.
copyFailed: Copy failed. Please select and copy the text manually.
sendFailed: Sending could not be confirmed. Check the conversation before trying again. Your draft is still available to copy.
stale: The conversation has changed. You can still copy your unsent draft.
unavailable: Suggestion unavailable. Check Claude sign-in and connectivity. Prediction will run again after the next reply.
saveError: Could not save settings. Please try again.
enabledHint: Generate one suggestion when its conversation row is mounted on a client. Unopened conversations do not call the model. Turning this off cancels pending predictions.
privacy: Uses the selected model through the host's Claude CLI account, endpoint and proxy, consuming that account's usage. Haiku is the default. Each prediction sends up to 8 recent user messages and assistant replies, limited to 12,000 characters. Tool results, reasoning and attachment files are excluded. Tools, MCP, skills, custom hooks and thinking are disabled. Each turn shares one request across clients, with no automatic retry. If Claude CLI is missing, no suggestion is shown; check its status here.
storage: Suggestions appear below the latest reply; Paseo manages timeline storage and restoration. Click the paper plane to send, or the text to edit in place. Copy is also available. Predictions are not saved as Claude sessions.
modelHint: Select Custom to use this ID. Letters, digits, dots, underscores, hyphens and square brackets only; cannot start with a hyphen.
invalidModel: Enter a valid model ID before saving.
cliMissing: Claude CLI not found. Searched locations:
cliError: Could not check Claude CLI. Try again.
needsEdit: This suggestion contains sensitive actions or references. Edit its wording before sending.
